create_masked_amax: compute the maximum of tensor elements along a dimension while masking out specified elements
create_masked_amin: compute the minimum of tensor elements along a dimension while masking out specified elements
create_masked_argmax: find the index of the maximum value in tensor elements along a dimension ignoring masked elements
create_masked_argmin: find the index of the minimum value in tensor elements along a dimension ignoring masked elements
create_masked_softmax: compute softmax of tensor slices along a dimension while ignoring masked-out elements
